changes.evidence: At the end of Black Panther, after M'Baku brings the Jabari to fight Killmonger at Mount Bashenga, he takes a seat on Wakanda's Tribal Council for the Jabari, ending their centuries of self-isolation from Wakanda; in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever he goes on to challenge for and take the throne of Wakanda. The A:m-baku file already records this as [The Jabari Tribe, Black Panther] then [Wakanda, Black Panther].
